name: Screens
author: IM0001GT
description: Snap-to-edge monitor layout with brightness, text size, HDR, VRR, hardware-aware profiles, optional bar dim, and workspace spreading with names, icons, and a configurable total

barWidget.description: Arrange monitors with snap, then set brightness, text size, refresh, HDR, and VRR. Optionally dim the bar and pin workspaces per screen (default 10, up to 99).
